ops.body: Scheduling clarification: as each component's final branch is coherent, please open its draft PR and start CI immediately in parallel with cc-sync E2E/cross-repo review. Synckit/reposync/Orca PR creation and CI do not depend on the final cc-sync acceptance verdict; keep them draft until their remaining checks land. This also gives concrete links and catches branch CI issues without a serial tail. No auto-merge or live rollout.
